scope: One independent coherent source/test/docs gate for V6 direct ordinary execution, private Agent query embedding composition, and native pre-session admission envelope.
policy: Acceptance policy v2: requirements/tests/completeness >=4, code/pattern >=3, zero breaking findings.

requirements.ordinaryScheduling: Original claim/execution and scheduled Action identity commit atomically; direct state prevents duplicate preparation/provider replay.
requirements.failureRecovery: Original failed/cancelled/UNKNOWN disposition and unchanged lease-bound retirement; public reconciliation recovers canonical final output or a persisted first-result continuation, never repeats ordinal0 inference.
requirements.workflowCompatibility: Strict new definitions keep V5 barriers/deadlines; V1-V5 bodies/callbacks unchanged; additive V6 tool journal owns original approval/tool loop and retry:false later Actions.
requirements.freshContext: Original executePreparedModelStep/contextHandler fully restored and byte identical. Rejected static prepared-hook prototype is not accepted.
requirements.embeddingPreflight: Original current Agent, authority, profile/readiness/preparation and two resolution predicates retained; returned proposals do not authorize dispatch.
requirements.embeddingAdmission: Fresh attempt/input/text/requestId/profile/semantic/ordinal/budget/reference/source/parent/request checks; original admit plus original nested checkpoint.
requirements.accounting: Checkpoint refusal commits reservation and rolls back child only; lost permit cannot fund another provider call; capture and private attachment remain independently durable; confirmed UNKNOWN replay resolves/admit freshly without a provider repeat.
requirements.recallTail: Original post-embedding validation, vector/fact overlap, deterministic order/error priority, bindings, source/fact/profile delivery and Action expiry retained; generic recall/ingestion unchanged.
requirements.sdkAdmission: Native original pre-session before writes + independent fresh post-I/O session; actor/scope/generation/expiry/DTO checks, original return and uncertainty/no-retry contract; ordinary path two RPCs.
